claims.subject: Arla Foods and DMK Group
claims.claim: DMK announced that Arla Foods and the DMK Group officially united on 1 June 2026 and that the combined company continues under the Arla name.
claims.source_title: DMK — Arla Foods und DMK Group fusionieren offiziell
claims.boundary: The Arla group identity after the merger does not mean every DMK legal entity disappeared or was renamed.
claims.falsification_condition: A current corporate or official record materially corrects the merger date or group identity.

claims.subject: Combined Arla/DMK organisation
claims.claim: The merger announcement states that the combined organisation brings together around 11,200 farmers and 28,800 employees.
claims.source_title: DMK — Arla Foods und DMK Group fusionieren offiziell
claims.boundary: Farmer and employee counts do not identify individual farms, milk flows, ownership rights or animal outcomes.
claims.falsification_condition: A newer Arla/DMK disclosure materially changes the combined farmer or employee counts.

claims.subject: Combined Arla/DMK organisation
claims.object: 19.4bn kg annual milk pool and >€20bn pro-forma revenue
claims.claim: The merger announcement reports a combined annual milk pool of 19.4 billion kilograms and pro-forma annual revenue above €20 billion.
claims.source_title: DMK — Arla Foods und DMK Group fusionieren offiziell
claims.boundary: Combined milk and revenue figures do not allocate volume or impact to Germany, a particular farm, dairy, brand or product.
claims.falsification_condition: A current merger or financial disclosure materially restates the combined figures.

claims.subject: DMK GmbH and its subsidiaries
claims.object: Arla Foods while retaining legal status
claims.claim: DMK states that DMK GmbH and its subsidiaries became subsidiaries of Arla Foods as part of the 2026 merger and retain their legal status.
claims.source_title: DMK — Arla Foods und DMK Group fusionieren offiziell
claims.boundary: This is exactly why ZSI must not auto-merge the current Arla parent identity with DMK GmbH or its subsidiaries.
claims.falsification_condition: A subsequent corporate filing shows a merger, liquidation or legal-status change for DMK GmbH or a named subsidiary.

claims.subject: DMK Group
claims.object: €5.3bn revenue, 3,900 owners, 6,800 employees and 5.1bn kg milk
claims.claim: DMK's 2026 merger materials report that the pre-merger DMK Group had €5.3 billion revenue, 3,900 farmer owners, 6,800 employees and 5.1 billion kilograms of milk volume.
claims.source_title: DMK — Arla Foods und DMK Group fusionieren offiziell
claims.boundary: These figures describe the pre-merger DMK Group and must not be presented as the current standalone scale of a separate DMK Group after 1 June 2026.
claims.falsification_condition: A corrected or audited historical disclosure materially restates the 2025 DMK figures.

claims.subject: DMK eG and DOC Kaas U.A.
claims.object: a European Cooperative Society as an intermediate step toward Arla
claims.claim: On 1 July 2026 DMK reported that DMK eG and DOC Kaas U.A. had approved a cross-border merger into a European Cooperative Society, designed as an intermediate step before that cooperative merges into Arla during the agreed transition.
claims.source_title: DMK — Members’ Meeting Approves Merger with DOC Kaas U.A.
claims.boundary: An approved intermediate cooperative restructuring is not the same event as the separate operating-company subsidiary relationship of DMK GmbH.
claims.falsification_condition: A later official cooperative/corporate record supersedes the described transition structure or timing.
